description: RCMDM 4th BOD Meeting at residence of Bharti and Dilip Gurjar at Bhimrao Wadi, Thakurdwar, Mumbai 400002 with a single point agenda to approve an ELECTOR to vote for DGNG-2029-30 election of RID 3141 and to decide which candidate to support and vote for amongst the 2 candidates standing for the post. Upon unanimous decision, the meeting culminated in high tea and snacks and then was followed by the 7th Regular Meeting of RCMD.
